title: opengl
summary: Report deterministic RunMat renderer compatibility information.
description: `opengl` provides MATLAB-compatible renderer status and information commands for scripts that probe or select graphics rendering modes. RunMat maps these calls onto the `runmat-plot` renderer instead of exposing a process-global native OpenGL switch.

arguments.name: command
arguments.description: Renderer command: `info`, `data`, `hardware`, `hardwarebasic`, `software`, `save`, `autoselect`, or `neverselect`. `opengl('save', mode)` accepts `hardware`, `hardwarebasic`, `software`, `autoselect`, or `none`.

notes: `opengl('info')` and `opengl('data')` return a struct with MATLAB-style fields such as `Version`, `Vendor`, `Renderer`, `HardwareSupportLevel`, `Software`, and `MaxTextureSize`.
Mode-selection commands are deterministic compatibility operations; they do not replace the `runmat-plot` backend or install a native OpenGL context.
gpu_residency: `opengl` reports renderer metadata only. It does not affect gpuArray residency or provider dispatch.
